storageTarget.description: whether the goods go to one of the user's own warehouses or to the warehouse exchange

warehouse.description: the user's warehouse that will receive the goods

customer.description: the customer or consignee the load is posted for, or none

cargoType.description: whether the shipment is a full or part load (FTL, LTL, FCL, LCL)

hsCode.description: the HS customs tariff code of the goods, or none

packaging.description: how the goods are packaged (the packaging method), or none

pallets.description: the pallet or unit count, including zero or none

dimensions.description: the dimensions or volume, or whether they are unknown/not needed

containers.description: the container types and how many of each are needed

bodyType.description: the trailer or body type, or whether none is required

vehicleType.description: the required vehicle type, or whether there is no preference

loadingEquipment.description: loading or unloading equipment requirements, or none

dangerousGoods.description: the dangerous-goods details (UN number, class, packing group, proper shipping name), or none

outOfGauge.description: whether the cargo is in gauge or out of gauge, and by how much if out of gauge

specialRequirements.description: one or more special requirements or notes, or none; explicitly mention that multiple options may be selected

transportMode.description: the air/sea transport mode, or none

pickup.description: the pickup city, country, and address if available

pickupDate.description: the pickup date or date/time window

delivery.description: the delivery city, country, and address if available

deliveryDate.description: the delivery date or date/time window

transitDays.description: the expected transit time in days, or none

extraStops.description: any further pickup or delivery stops beyond the first of each, or none

storageType.description: the storage conditions the goods need

storageEquipment.description: the warehouse equipment the goods need, or none; explicitly mention that multiple options may be selected

storagePeriod.description: the storage start and end date, or whether the storage is ongoing

storageTemperature.description: the storage temperature range, or none

storageServices.description: the warehouse services required, or none; explicitly mention that multiple options may be selected

storageRate.description: how the storage price should be quoted

declaredValue.description: the declared cargo value and currency, or none

terms.description: Incoterm and deferred-payment terms, or none

requirements.description: special handling and service requirements, or none

contact.description: the contact name and available phone or email details, or none

supplier.description: the supplier contact for the goods, or none

visibility.description: whether the load is published openly or limited to a closed exchange first, or none

comments.description: internal or offer comments, or none

notes.description: any final notes, booking reference, or custom items, or none
